Eligible businesses must keep their RAMIS details, bank information, schedules and supporting records accurate and provide information for checks; the gazette also sets October and November 2025 deadlines for closing outstanding SVAT transactions.

Non-resident suppliers must register when the stated turnover thresholds are exceeded, charge VAT at the applicable rate (currently 18%), remit it by the 20th of the following month, file quarterly returns and keep records. Consumers may see VAT charged on these services, while platform operators must exclude the value of goods or services supplied directly by the original supplier when calculating their own taxable service value.

Tourists may claim a refund of 80% of the VAT-exclusive value of eligible goods taken out of Sri Lanka, provided the purchases total at least Rs. 50,000 excluding VAT, are covered by no more than three invoices per day, and are made from an Authorized Retailer. Bottled water, aerated water, cooked meals, and goods that have been fully or partly consumed are excluded.

Eligible projects include listed manufacturing, engineering, cold-storage or refrigerated transport, export production villages, offshore-company management or back-office operations, and projects with investment above Rs. 250 million. The company must provide evidence of its investment and must not reduce or withdraw that investment during the exemption period; otherwise, its profits and income become liable to income tax from the relevant year of assessment in which operations began.

gazettes.subject: income-tax
gazettes.summary: Companies engaged in specified infrastructure activities may qualify for an income tax exemption on their profits and income. The activities include airports, seaports, highways, railways, industrial parks, warehouses, sanitation and waste management, power, water services, urban housing or own center development, and hospitals; the exemption lasts 6 to 12 years depending on investment of Rs. 1,000 million or more, provided the investment is fully made within one year after commercial operations begin.
